mission.title: The Stolen Artifact
mission.description: Intercept an artifact that was stolen from the Merovingian.

phase.briefing:
As you may have heard, the Merovingian recently had an artifact stolen from him that we would like to ... intercept. The artifact was lifted by a small band of Exiles that operate outside of the Merovingian's rule.
We have the location of the Exiles' stronghold. This will be a dangerous mission ... prove to us that we have chosen the appropriate operative.

enter.say: The Exiles are scattered all over the area ... I'm afraid I don't know the exact location of the artifact, so you'll have to run a thorough search.

objective.text: Find information on who has the artifact

phase.briefing: I have sent you the address of Lindqvist's Laboratory. Only she can decipher the documents.

objective.text: Get the dossier on Marsh from Lindqvist's computer

phase.briefing: Captain Antares and his crew are inside a nearby REP. Find Antares and get the artifact from him by any means possible. You have been updated with the proper coordinates for the Redpill Extraction Point.

enter.say: The Redpill Extraction Point is inside this building.

objective.text: Kill Antares and the crew of the Prodito

phase.briefing: You have been updated with the drop-off point. Go there now before additional attempts are made to steal the artifact.

enter.say: Make sure that the artifact is returned to Agent Corwin.

objective.text: Deliver the artifact to Agent Corwin
